consultant.title: Consultant assistant
consultant.description: Your copilot across the whole portfolio: analyse clients, projects and processes, and line up the next steps.
prompts: Summarise the status of at-risk projects
Which decisions are waiting on me?
Draft the agenda for the next steering committee
Open a new project for a client

project.title: Project chat
project.description: Reason across the whole project: progress, processes in scope, risks and open decisions.
prompts: List the processes in scope and their readiness
Generate the management summary for the sponsor

process.title: Process chat
process.description: Work on this process: AS-IS evidence, roles, exceptions and the handoff to the BPMN model.
prompts: Summarise the evidence gathered so far
What information is missing to model the process?
List roles and exceptions still to confirm
Prepare the brief to generate the BPMN

canvas.title: Canvas chat
canvas.description: Edit the BPMN model in words: the assistant updates the diagram and checks it stays consistent.
prompts: Generate the BPMN from the process evidence
What is missing to build the model?
List the activities that emerged from the sources
promptsModeled: Walk me through the current model step by step
Validate the coverage of roles and exceptions
Assign an owner role to every activity

conversation.label: Chat
conversation.hint: Conversation only: answers and clarifies without creating BPMN reviews, questions or artifacts.

plan.label: Plan
plan.hint: Understands and proposes: prepares and reworks the process plan without touching the canvas.

edit.label: Edit
edit.hint: Applies the change you asked for, narrowly, without re-planning.

agent.label: Agent
agent.hint: Full loop: plans, applies and verifies until the request is closed.

low.label: Fast
low.hint: Quick answer. For direct questions and small corrections.

medium.label: Balanced
medium.hint: Trades time against depth. Fits most turns.

high.label: Deep
high.hint: Thinks longer before answering. For analysis and complex plans.

note.title: Attach text
note.placeholder: Paste the minutes, email or note here.

queue.title: Queued messages
queue.hint: They go out as soon as the running turn closes.

deleteSession.title: Delete this conversation?
deleteSession.body: The questions and answers in this thread go away. There is no undo.

clearHistory.title: Clear the whole history?
clearHistory.body: Every conversation in this workspace goes away, not just the open one. There is no undo.

review.openHint: Open the review to check the plan before generating the canvas.

review.decideBody: These points are deliberately kept out of the flow: deciding here avoids drawing assumptions into the process.
review.historyBody: Every state of the plan stays readable: what changed, why, and how much the structure moved from the previous version.
review.qualityBody: The assessment separates completeness, clarity and risk before generation.
